versus.title: Legacy ESG platforms compared with Nexus

pillars.heading: Three things sustainability teams ask for.
pillars.subheading: They are also the three things every other tool gets wrong. We rebuilt the stack so each one is a first-class citizen.

compliance.title: Compliance-grade reporting
compliance.body: CSRD, ISSB, GRI, TCFD, CDP, SEC — out of the box. Every disclosure is auditable, with a blockchain-anchored trail back to the original data point.

ai.title: AI that drafts and extracts
ai.body: AI narrative drafting, evidence extraction from supplier PDFs, and vendor-to-emission-factor matching — Claude by default, or a mainland China model provider per organisation. Humans approve every number.

linkedData.title: Linked data, one source of truth
linkedData.body: Change a value once. It propagates to every framework, every disclosure, every chart it appears in. Auditors love it; analysts get their evenings back.

capabilities.heading: Everything an ESG team needs in one place.

workflow.title: Workflow & approvals
workflow.body: Multi-stage review chains with SO / TL / PM roles and automatic escalation.

emissionFactors.title: Emission factor library
emissionFactors.body: DEFRA, EPA, IPCC and custom factors. Versioned. Audit-traced. Always up-to-date.

blockchain.title: Blockchain audit trail
blockchain.body: Every published figure gets a tamper-evident hash. Anyone can verify with the token.

sso.title: SAML SSO & SCIM
sso.body: Azure AD, Okta, Google Workspace, JumpCloud. SCIM auto-provisioning included.

spreadsheets.title: Excel-style spreadsheets
spreadsheets.body: Bulk entry that feels like Excel — with validation, formulas, and one-click import.

residency.title: Multi-region residency
residency.body: EU and US data residency. Self-host with our Terraform module if you need full control.

enterprise.description: For groups, regulated industries, and on-prem.

workiva.q: How does Nexus compare to Workiva?
workiva.a: We focus narrowly on sustainability reporting — that lets us go deeper on emission factors, supplier data, and framework-specific disclosure logic. Pricing is also a fraction of Workiva for comparable teams. See the full /compare page for an honest head-to-head.

frameworks.a: CSRD/ESRS, ISSB (IFRS S1 & S2), GRI Universal + topic standards, TCFD, CDP, SEC climate disclosure, California SB 253 / SB 261 and the EU Taxonomy — plus China's SSE / SZSE / BSE guidelines, the MOF CSDS basic standard, the HKEX ESG Code and CASS-ESG. New packs are added as standards mature.

timeline.a: Most teams get a CSRD-ready draft in 48 hours, self-serve. No consultants required, no professional services fees. See /how-it-works for the hour-by-hour breakdown.

storage.a: EU (Frankfurt) by default. US (Virginia) on request. Self-hosted via our Terraform module deploys to your own AWS / Azure / GCP project — your data never leaves your VPC.

residency.q: Do you support EU and US data residency?
residency.a: Yes. Both regions on the Team plan, with regional segregation guaranteed. Enterprise customers can add additional regions or on-prem deployments.

api.a: Yes. REST + JSON, fully versioned. Every action in the UI is available via API, including evidence upload, disclosure publishing, and verification. SDKs for Python and TypeScript are in beta.

china.q: Does Nexus support Chinese listed-company reporting?
china.a: Yes. China framework packs (SSE / SZSE / BSE guidelines, MOF CSDS, HKEX ESG Code, CASS-ESG), MEE emission factors, Simplified Chinese PDF and Word reports, and DingTalk / Feishu / WeCom notifications are built in. Mainland hosting is not offered today — talk to us about your deployment requirements.

frameworks.heading: Every framework your exchange, regulator and investors ask for.
frameworks.lead: Framework packs ship with the product — question sets, units and mappings included. Global standards and China's exchange guidelines sit side by side.
frameworks.note: The framework catalogue as it ships in the product. Names identify the standards; they do not imply endorsement.

china.heading: Built for A-share and A+H disclosure.
china.lead: Report against the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing exchange guidelines, the Ministry of Finance basic standard and the HKEX ESG Code from the same approved data — in Simplified Chinese and English.

frameworks.title: China framework packs
frameworks.body: SSE / SZSE / BSE guidelines (2024 trial), MOF CSDS, HKEX ESG Code (Appendix C2) and CASS-ESG 5.0.

factors.title: MEE emission factors
factors.body: 2023 national and regional grid factors from MEE and NBS, plus GB/T 32150 fuel defaults — preferred automatically for China organisations.

reports.title: Chinese PDF and Word reports
reports.body: Reports render in Simplified Chinese with embedded CJK fonts and proper line breaking, in PDF, Word and iXBRL.

bilingual.title: Language per person
bilingual.body: Each person works in English or 简体中文. The market — frameworks, factors, AI provider — is set per organisation.

im.title: DingTalk, Feishu and WeCom
im.body: Assignment, review and approval notifications post to your group chats through each organisation's own bot webhooks.

ai.title: Mainland-compatible AI
ai.body: Per organisation, route AI drafting to an OpenAI-compatible mainland model provider, label AI-generated text, or switch AI off.

pricing.heading: Published pricing. No sales call required.
pricing.lead: Start free, and upgrade when your team is ready.
